shortage_interpretation: WIP supply insufficiency / flow-continuity risk proxy
internal_consistency_note: below-low-time and below-low-ratio correlations are definition-linked internal consistency metrics, not independent validation evidence
cross_instance_note: raw shortage is not normalized by capacity, active horizon, job count, or makespan and should not be compared as absolute quality across instances
low_wip_note: the frozen low_wip is capacity-dependent, so tightness-level raw shortage differences are not pure capacity effects
